voice-profile.built-from: 50 Robin X/Twitter posts (casual voice baseline for TikTok and Instagram)

fingerprint.sentence-length: extremely short — 51.5% of lines are 5 words or fewer. Punchy standalone statements. Medium lines (6-12 words) fill gaps at 43%. Long sentences almost never appear
fingerprint.paragraph-length: 1-3 words to 1 short sentence per line. Lots of line breaks. Single-word lines OK. Reads like conversation, not paragraphs
fingerprint.opener-style: lowercase or ALL CAPS — 32% start lowercase (casual vibe), 6% ALL CAPS for excitement. pov: format for story setups. Contrarian openers common ("Don't use Cursor", "$5/month is too expensive"). Self-deprecating works well ("I'm stupid"). Celebration openers for milestones ("WE CROSSED $1000 MRR")
fingerprint.word-choice: conversational and unfiltered — "gonna", "gotta", "af", "wtf", "lol". Signature phrases: "this changed my life", "I'm living the dream", "no one's coming to save us", "becoming successful is the only option". Simple words over sophisticated vocab. Money amounts create engagement ($1M ARR, $700)
fingerprint.punctuation: minimal overall. lowercase default. Emojis in 26% — celebration 🎉, reactions 😭, emphasis 👎. Multiple exclamation marks for milestones. No comma-heavy sentences. Occasional ellipsis for cliffhangers
fingerprint.first-person: very high — raw personal experience IS the content. "I made", "we crossed", "I'm done", "I quit". Shares wins unabashedly. Shares failures and stupid mistakes too. Vulnerability is a feature
fingerprint.cta-style: question or challenge — "what's your move?", "be honest", "keep going guys". Inclusive: "grinding until we're all millionaires". Sometimes no CTA — drops the mic and leaves

hook.example: $5/month for a VPS is too expensive.
Don't use Cursor for new Projects.
I love working 9-5 on a monday

hook.pattern: [Milestone or achievement] — ALL CAPS or emoji explosion

hook.example: pov: you're getting rich with your friends
pov: building a startup in a barber shop in africa
I'm stupid — accidentally purchased my own product today while testing
I'm turning 24 tomorrow — still haven't made it…
this changed my life! [then lists contrast of last year vs this year]
imagine this: you get a macbook, no job, you're broke — you have 30 days to make $1,000 online — what's your move?

localization-de.note: German TikTok uses this same casual profile with DE localization on top
localization-de.principle: Preserve raw energy — "brooo" in German: Alter, Bruder, krass
Keep lowercase where German grammar allows
Adapt milestone posts to German entrepreneur culture — same raw excitement
Do NOT literal-translate — find German phrases with same casual punch
Avoid formal German grammar — use spoken German
